newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Soquimich started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Soquimich started as buy.

text.p: HSBC James Capel analyst Jane Winslow has started coverage of Chile's Sociedad Quimica y Minera de Chile, or Soquimich, with a rating of buy.
-- "Soquimich commands a dominant position in most of its markets and has a comparative cost advantage vis a vis the competition," she wrote in a May 29 report.
-- "The company's exclusive rights to high-grade caliche ore deposits and mineral-rich underground brines in the Salar de Atacama are key."
-- She expects earnings-per-share growth of 31 percent in 1998. The 12-month target price is $80 for the American Depositary Receipt.
-- Soquimich was off 1/4 at 64-3/4. The company is the world's biggest producer of natural nitrate fertilizers and iodine.
